nodes.label: alternateSourceUrls Stage 3 fallback rationale
nodes.rationale: Stage 1 web_search fallback URLs are persisted (URL only, no title/summary) so processSelectedTopics() can thread them into Stage 3 as searchSummaries, giving a dashboard-selected candidate a real fallback source if the primary sourceUrl is unfetchable (bot-blocked, paywalled, redirect loop) — matching the automated pipeline's existing behavior.
